This site renders the `wfrc-brand` extension on three pages. Each one is checked in light and dark mode and at phone width.

::: {.wfrc-blocks}
::: {.wfrc-block}
### Components

Every element the theme styles: headings, callouts, code, tabsets, tables, charts and inputs.

[Open the preview](example.qmd){.btn .btn-sm}
:::

::: {.wfrc-block .mid}
### Landing page

The hero, color blocks, key facts and update list, built from `.wfrc-*` classes.

[Open the preview](example-landing.qmd){.btn .btn-sm}
:::

::: {.wfrc-block .brick}
### Dashboard

Value boxes, cards and charts with `format: wfrc-brand-dashboard`.

[Open the preview](example-dashboard.qmd){.btn .btn-sm}
:::
:::

## Use it

```bash
quarto add WFRCAnalytics/wfrc-brand
```

Setup, design tokens, component classes and the migration checklist are in the [README](https://github.com/WFRCAnalytics/wfrc-brand#readme).
